# Analyze fleet-wide yellowtail performance by class and day for S6
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

trips = tables['trips']

# Filter for season 6, day 60+
s6_trips = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 60)].copy()

# Calculate yt/angler by class and date
fleet_by_day_cls = s6_trips.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

fleet_by_day_cls['yt_per_angler'] = fleet_by_day_cls['yt'] / fleet_by_day_cls['anglers']
fleet_by_day_cls = fleet_by_day_cls[fleet_by_day_cls['yt'] > 0]  # filter zeros
fleet_by_day_cls = fleet_by_day_cls.sort_values('fished_date_doy')

fleet_by_day_cls = s6_trips.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

fleet_by_day_cls['yt_per_angler'] = fleet_by_day_cls['yt'] / fleet_by_day_cls['anglers']
fleet_by_day_cls = fleet_by_day_cls[fleet_by_day_cls['yt'] > 0]  # filter zeros
fleet_by_day_cls = fleet_by_day_cls.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("=== TOP 30 DAYS OVERALL (ANY CLASS, S6 D60-D121) ===")
top30 = fleet_by_day_cls.head(30)
for idx, row in top30.iterrows():
    print(f"D{row['fished_date_doy']:.0f} {row['cls']:12s}: {row['yt_per_angler']:.2f} yt/angler ({row['yt']:.0f} yt / {row['anglers']:.0f} anglers)")

# Now look at trends by class
print("\n\n=== SUMMARY BY CLASS ===")
fleet_by_cls = s6_trips.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).reset_index()

fleet_by_cls = fleet_by_cls.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
for idx, row in fleet_by_cls.iterrows():
    print(f"{row['cls']:12s}: {row['yt_per_angler']:.2f} yt/angler ({row['yt']:.0f} total yt)")

# Identify top-performing boats in S6 D60-D121
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[(trips['fished_date_season'] == 6) & (trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 60)].copy()

# Calculate yt/angler by boat
boat_perf = s6_trips.groupby('boat').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

boat_perf['yt_per_angler'] = boat_perf['yt'] / boat_perf['anglers']
boat_perf = boat_perf[boat_perf['yt'] >= 50].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)  # min 50 yt threshold

print("=== TOP PERFORMING BOATS (S6 D60-D121, ≥50 yt total) ===\n")
for idx, row in boat_perf.head(20).iterrows():
    print(f"{row['boat']:20s}: {row['yt_per_angler']:.2f} yt/angler ({row['yt']:.0f} yt / {row['anglers']:.0f} anglers)")

# Now check which boats I booked
my_bookings = [
    ('Prowler', 93),      # D93 overnight 
    ('Prowler', 101),     # D101 overnight
    ('Invicta', 108),     # Booked but rejected, later Mission Belle
    ('Mission Belle', 109), # D109 three_quarter
    ('Legend', 115)       # D115 overnight
]

print("\n\n=== MY BOAT PICKS vs TOP PERFORMERS ===")
for boat, day in my_bookings:
    boat_data = boat_perf[boat_perf['boat'] == boat]
    if len(boat_data) > 0:
        perf = boat_data.iloc[0]
        print(f"D{day} {boat:20s}: {perf['yt_per_angler']:.2f} yt/angler (I got ~0-1.1 share)")
    else:
        print(f"D{day} {boat:20s}: No data or <50 yt threshold")

result = "Boat analysis complete"
